Picopt, a lossless image optimizer utility

I found this program a few days ago and it's the best one I've tried yet. It uses external tools like optipng, jpegrescan, and mozjpeg to do the optimizing, but unlike any of these tools it utilises multiple processor cores by optimizing more than one image at a time. It can also optimize comic book archives which is a plus for comic book collectors.

I tested it on a folder of 100 JPEG photos and got an average file size reduction of 8%. PNGs are usually reduced further, depending on the type of image.

Since Mozilla doesn't provide binary releases of mozjpeg yet I had to compile it from source. It was surprisingly simple though, there were hardly any dependencies apart from normal build tools.
